summary: Kept MCP entries from lockless write evidence were reported inaccurately: apm install <bundle>, apm install --mcp NAME and apm mcp install NAME did not announce them, a stale key-less record kept producing notices after its entry was retired, a server redeclared on the same native key was still announced as kept, and unusable evidence other than a parse error was not announced on a lockless install. Reporting only; nothing is removed differently.
